t: What automotive rubber parts do you manufacture?
b: We manufacture a wide range of automotive rubber parts including CV Joint Boots, Driveshaft Boots, Steering Rack Boots, Shock Absorber Boots, Stabilizer Bar Bushings, Rubber O-Rings, Valve Cover Gaskets , and other custom rubber sealing components.

t: Which vehicle systems are your rubber parts used for?
b: Our rubber parts are mainly used in steering systems, suspension systems, drivetrain systems, engine sealing systems, and hydraulic systems , providing sealing, dust protection, vibration reduction, and oil leak prevention.

t: Do you support OEM and ODM rubber parts manufacturing?
b: Yes. We provide complete OEM & ODM rubber manufacturing services , including product design support, rubber material selection, mold development, sample testing, and stable mass production.

t: Can you produce custom rubber parts based on drawings or samples?
b: Yes. We support custom rubber parts manufacturing based on 2D / 3D drawings, physical samples, or application requirements , and offer technical optimization to improve sealing performance and service life.

t: Which rubber materials do you use?
b: We mainly use NBR, Viton (FKM), Silicone, and ACM rubber materials , selected according to oil resistance, heat resistance, chemical exposure, and operating environment requirements.

t: How do you ensure the quality of automotive rubber parts?
b: We implement strict quality control throughout the production process, from raw material inspection and molding control to final dimensional and performance inspection, ensuring OEM-level quality consistency.

t: Are your rubber parts suitable for aftermarket and OEM supply?
b: Yes. Our rubber parts are supplied to both OEM manufacturers and automotive aftermarket distributors , suitable for original equipment, replacement, and export markets.

t: How can I start cooperation or request a quotation?
b: You can contact us via our OEM inquiry form or request a quote by submitting drawings, samples, application details, and estimated order quantity. Our team will respond promptly with technical and commercial support.
